subject: Marketplace billing paths, VAT and W-8/W-9 requirements for co-sell
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <elena.p@cloudcorp.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudcorp.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice & tax forms for Redwood purchase via AWS Marketplace

Hi Karthik,

Quick question from our procurement team — we subscribed to Redwood via AWS Marketplace last week (order id: AWS-987654). Our AP team is asking whether Redwood will provide an invoice showing VAT breakdown and whether we should expect to receive a Redwood-issued invoice or an AWS Marketplace invoice. They also asked which tax form (W-8/W-9) you need from CloudCorp for accounting.

Can you confirm:
- Who issues the invoice to the buyer for Marketplace purchases (AWS vs Redwood)?
- If AWS issues the invoice, can Redwood still provide a vendor invoice for our records (VAT split, Redwood tax id)?
- Which tax form do you need from us to complete vendor onboarding (we are a US entity)?

Thanks — we want to get this wrapped quickly so AP can close the PO.

Best,
Elena
Elena Petrova
Head of Finance, CloudCorp
(Attachment: AWS-order-987654.pdf (pdf))

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena.p@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & tax forms for Redwood purchase via AWS Marketplace

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and congrats on getting started with Redwood. Short answers up front, then a couple of options depending on whether the purchase was processed fully on AWS Marketplace or as a co-sell transaction.

Summary:
- AWS Marketplace purchases are invoiced by AWS to the buyer. AWS will provide the commercial invoice to CloudCorp. Redwood receives payment from AWS net of marketplace fees.
- If you need a Redwood vendor invoice (for internal reconciliation / VAT details), we can provide a supplemental invoice or a "vendor statement" — but it does not replace the AWS invoice for tax reporting in many jurisdictions.
- For U.S. entities, we typically request a completed W-9. For non-US entities we'd request a W-8BEN-E.

A few clarifying Qs so we can give the right documents:
1) Was this purchase made directly through your AWS Marketplace console under CloudCorp’s billing account (i.e., AWS charged you), or did you accept an Azure/GCP co-sell quote from our team?
2) Do you require Redwood’s EIN and VAT registration details on a vendor invoice, or is a vendor statement sufficient for AP?
3) Are you expecting VAT to be shown as a separate line item (EU buyers / reverse charge) or treated as part of the AWS invoice?

I’ve attached a short guidance PDF and a draft W-8/W-9 checklist. Looping in Laura (partnerships) and Rishi (billing ops) so they can confirm what we can supply for AWS-sourced orders.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
(karthik.iyer@redwood.com)
(Attachment: Redwood-EIN-and-tax-info.pdf (pdf))

From: Elena Petrova <elena.p@cloudcorp.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudcorp.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & tax forms for Redwood purchase via AWS Marketplace

Hi Karthik — thanks. Confirming: the charge landed on our AWS bill (so AWS is the billed party). AP will accept an AWS invoice for payment but they prefer a Redwood vendor document that includes Redwood’s tax id and a line that shows our internal mapping (subscription id).

They asked: is the W-9 sufficient for vendor setup or do you need anything else? Also, our AP has never asked for a vendor statement vs invoice — what does Redwood usually deliver in these cases?

If you can send a one-page vendor statement we can attach it to our invoice. Also happy to sign any W-9 via DocuSign.

Best,
Elena

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, elena.p@cloudcorp.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice & tax forms for Redwood purchase via AWS Marketplace

Hi Elena and team — looping in billing ops (Rishi) and finance partner (Monica) to confirm exact artifacts. A couple of operational notes that clarify what we can provide: 

1) AWS Marketplace (US/EU): AWS invoices the buyer. For EU buyers, AWS typically issues the VAT invoice under their EU VAT registration. That means the buyer receives VAT documentation from AWS. Redwood can provide a supplemental vendor invoice/statement showing our breakdown (revenue share, marketplace fee, Redwood’s tax id/EIN) for your internal mapping. This is a common ask and we can produce it on company letterhead.

2) W-9 vs W-8: Since CloudCorp is a US entity, a W-9 is what we need for our records. The W-8 series are for non-US entities. We can also accept a signed copy via DocuSign.

3) Co-sell/direct purchases: If the deal had been invoiced directly by Redwood (direct contract or dedicated account), Redwood would issue the full invoice with VAT/EIN information. Since this was an AWS Marketplace transaction, AWS is the biller to the buyer.

4) Timeline: Rishi — can you add the vendor-statement PDF and an official W-9 DocuSign link in this thread? We should include Redwood's EIN and a short explanation line: "This supplemental vendor statement is provided for buyer internal reconciliation and does not replace the AWS Marketplace invoice."

Thanks — happy to produce the file this morning.

Laura Bennett
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Hi all — attaching the vendor statement and a DocuSign link for the W-9. Quick notes:

- Attachment: Vendor-Statement-CloudCorp-2026-04-20.pdf (shows Redwood EIN: 12-3456789 and maps subscription id to AWS order id).
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/W9-sign/abcd1234 (please complete the W-9 so we can finalize your vendor profile).
- For EU buyers where reverse-charge applies, we include a short statement and our VAT id on the supplemental file; however the legal invoice for VAT reporting will still be the AWS invoice in most cases.
- If CloudCorp needs a Redwood-origin invoice (e.g., procurement policy requires vendor invoice regardless of marketplace flow) we can generate one, but it will be marked as "Supplemental vendor invoice — not a substitute for Marketplace billing" to avoid tax reporting conflicts.

Elena — attaching the files here. Let me know if AP needs the vendor statement as a PDF or as a letter on our letterhead; we can do either.

(Attachment: Vendor-Statement-CloudCorp-2026-04-20.pdf (pdf))

2) Redwood will provide the supplemental vendor statement (PDF) mapping subscription id AWS-987654 to our internal invoice id; include Redwood EIN and a one-line legal disclaimer about marketplace invoicing.

If AP completes the W-9 today we’ll email the finalized vendor statement and close the vendor setup. Let me know if you want me to connect you with Sam at AWS to request a detailed AWS invoice copy (sometimes AWS AP can produce additional detail on the marketplace invoice).

Thanks and talk soon — welcome to Redwood.
